desc: Ideation: derive trie-based reformulation and the `max(A_i, M2, M1 if M1 > D_i else 0)` formula
Implement full solution (trie construction, depth statistics M1/M2, per-word D_i/A_i query, `n-1 < k` early return) in one code block
Validate on Examples 1 and 2 and edge cases: k=1, n=1, all-identical words, nested prefixes (["ab","abc"], ["a","ab"]), duplicates
Reason through correctness of the formula (path has ≤1 node per depth ⇒ M2 always safe; d > D ⇒ good node off-path ⇒ M1 usable; d ≤ D with cntd==1 ⇒ node is the path node ⇒ needs cnt ≥ k+1 ⇒ A)
Performance sanity check: O(sum of lengths) time/memory, iterative build and traversal (no recursion), early `break` on cnt < k
